sections.voiceover: On trial in London, prosecutors accused the comedian of operating as a ruthless sexual predator over a decade. Which specific charges brought prosecutors into the courtroom against him?
However, three counts of rape formed only part of the indictment.

British prosecutors detailed three counts of sexual assault alongside one count of indecent assault. Associated Press reported the prosecution opening statements inside the courtroom. Six women form the core of the case.
Southwark Crown Court hears the ongoing trial involving fifty-one-year-old Russell Brand.
